plan.adaptation_hypothesis: Defenses rely on velocity; by extending dormancy and dwell times while keeping device novelty high, we simulate a dormant account waking up just enough to be flagged as suspicious but not malicious.

parameter_changes.rationale: Maximize the gap before activity to mimic long-dormant legitimate accounts, reducing velocity-based suspicion.
Keep outflow extremely rapid after payment initiation to avoid triggering post-transaction delay monitoring.
Force a new device signature to challenge device-binding heuristics while maintaining the low-and-slow narrative.
Use brand-new beneficiaries to force immediate risk assessment on the transaction side, relying on dwell time for mitigation.

plan.reasoning_summary: This plan adapts an easy-difficulty evasion campaign by maximizing dormancy and minimizing dwell time to create a 'sleep-and-sprint' profile. The high new_device_probability challenges device reputation systems, while zero beneficiary age forces immediate scrutiny that the rapid outflow aims to bypass before containment thresholds are reached. This tests whether defenses can distinguish between dormant account wake-ups and active fraud based solely on timing parameters.
